<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>Item 8.01 Other Events.</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><b>&#160;</b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">On September 2, 2026, FedEx Freight Holding Company, Inc.
(&#8220;FedEx Freight&#8221; or the &#8220;Company&#8221;) terminated Michael B. Lyons, Executive Vice President &#8211; Chief
Specialized Services and Commercial Officer. Following an internal investigation, the Company determined Mr. Lyons violated its Code
of Conduct and no longer met the standards of employment at FedEx Freight.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Mr. Lyons&#8217;s conduct was not related to and did not impact the
Company&#8217;s financial reporting or performance, internal controls, strategy, or customer relationships.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Responsibilities previously held by Mr. Lyons are transitioning
to members of the FedEx Freight executive leadership team while the Company conducts a comprehensive search for his replacement.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&#160;</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></p>
